## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
The world is still quiet, but the first hint of light has begun to rise beyond the window.
A CRT monitor hums softly at the center of the desk, terminal text scrolling with steady intention. Warm lamp light settles across notebooks, keys, and analog gear while the sky shifts from deep lavender toward soft pink. Everything feels calm, clean, and ready.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is designed for early focus sessions before the day fully wakes — ideal for coding, studying, writing, and uninterrupted creative work.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.
Best for:
- Pre-dawn coding and planning
- Studying and deep focus
- Writing and creative flow
- Calm productivity before sunrise
Aesthetic:
Soft dawn sky • CRT terminal glow • warm desk lamp • analog equipment • pastel window light • clean, focused atmosphere
